title: Cardinal Billing Account Renewal Down Payment Percentage by Payment Record
content:
**Rule.** The renewal down payment percentage of a Cardinal Billing Account is set by the account's payment record over the last 12 whole months: **30 percent** when the account has both a returned payment and a late fee in that window, **25 percent** when it has a returned payment or a late fee but not both, and the pay plan's down payment percentage when it has neither.

A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the bill date (the renewal bill date), counted on calendar months. A returned payment is a returned-payment entry on the account's billing history; a late fee is a late fee charged on the account.

## Truth table

| Returned payment in the window | Late fee in the window | Renewal down payment percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 30 percent |
| Yes | No | 25 percent |
| No | Yes | 25 percent |
| No | No | The pay plan's down payment percentage |

One returned payment or several, one late fee or several: what counts is whether the account has at least one of each kind in the window.

**Hypothetical cases.** An account with two late fees and no returned payment in the window: 25 percent. An account with one returned payment posted 11 whole months before the bill date and one late fee posted 2 months before it: 30 percent. The same account with the return posted 12 whole months before the bill date: the return falls outside the window, so 25 percent.
